description: Search the business websites Triremes measured with gaps in what search engines and AI answer engines can read, each one sold on its own: what kind of business and where, its gap score, its gaps and failed checks by name, when it was measured, its price and its page. The business, its website and its contacts are bought on that page.

business.description: A kind of business, such as Dentists or Roofing Contractors; when several kinds match, the answer lists them.

country.description: A country, as its two-letter ISO code (US, DE).

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the answer before, for the next page.

gap_score.description: Only websites with a gap score in this band: poor Poor: 50% or more, fair Fair: 20% to 49%, good Good: under 20%.
